messages:
ana: Quick sync — marketplace launch readiness for the cloud partner next month. Need to lock press embargo, joint blog, marketplace listing copy, and landing page assets. Who owns what?

matt: I can lead the press/blog + landing page. Need partner QA on messaging and a 1-paragraph customer quote by EOD Friday.

jules: From partner side I’ll coordinate the quote and approvals. Timeline: partner marketing needs a final draft 5 business days before the announced date.

signe: Legal check: embargo agreement + partner logos usage. Send me the draft NDA/embargo text and the logo spec. I’ll turn around in 48h.

sam-marketing: For the landing page we need: 1 hero headline, 3 product bullets, 2 screenshots (marketplace UI + console), and UTM links. I’ll make a WIP page at /marketing/drafts/marketplace-partner.

ana: (typo correction) ana: tagging @sam-marketing — are we doing a joint webinar or just blog + press for launch?

matt: Primary is press + joint blog + marketplace listing. Secondary: a demo webinar in week 2 post-launch. Keeps initial window clean for partner PMs.

jules: Partner prefers blog + press first. Webinar depends on customer interest.

signe: Also need to confirm data residency claims on the listing copy (partner asked about region availability). Add a short blurb about regions supported.

ana: (typo again) ana: noted. Matt, can you confirm embargo lift date? Partner PR team proposed 2024-09-15 09:00 PT.

matt: Proposed embargo lift: 1711420800 (2024-09-15 16:00 UTC). We should keep one backup date + hour.

jules: Partner ok with that time. They requested a 24h partner-only preview on the partner portal.

sam-marketing: Action items I have: 1) Draft landing page by 1711286400 (2024-09-22) for review, 2) UTM schema + tracking doc, 3) images (I need product screenshots by 1711240000).

matt: Press release draft in Google Drive: https://go.redwood/prs/marketplace-partner-dr. Please comment inline.

signe: Upload embargo agreement to the drive and @signe will add markups. Also confirm partner legal contact.

jules: Partner legal is emma@partnerco.com. I’ll loop them into the drive.

an a: (typo again) ana: small asks — marketplace listing requires: short description (140 chars), 2 long bullets, feature tags, logo svg, 1 privacy statement sentence. Partner must provide logo SVG + verified company description.

sam-marketing: I'll create templates for listing fields and share as a Google Sheet for partner completion.

matt: PR checklist: embargo doc signed, partner quote, final screenshot, landing page URL, PR contact list, AP-style headline options. I’ll mark items as green/red in sheet.

release-bot: deploy-notice: created campaign stub: campaigns/marketplace-partner-2024. Pending final assets and go/no-go.

ana: (typo) ana: rough timeline recap: T-21 days: draft PR & landing page. T-10 days: partner approvals & embargo signed. T-2 days: final assets in drive. Launch day: press + listing + blog. Post-launch week: webinar planning and tracking. Anyone object?

matt: Sounds good. One ask: coordinate social copy + partner handles — need those by T-3 days.

jules: Will get partner social handles and LinkedIn blueprint by T-4 days.

signe: I’ll confirm logo/legal usage and confirm privacy blurb by T-7 days.

sam-marketing: I’ll post the sheet here when ready and ping everyone.

ana: (typo) ana: perfect. I’ll book a 30m GTM sync for tomorrow to run the checklist: invite sent to @matt @jules @signe @sam-marketing.

matt: thanks — will join.

jules: joining.

signe: onboard.

sam-marketing: yep.

ana: (final) ana: moving forward — please add any blockers inline on the doc. If nothing else I’ll convert this to the official launch tracker after the sync. :rocket:
